CordenPharma is one of the leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMO) and develops and produces pharmaceutical active ingredients, pharmaceuticals and related packaging services on behalf of its customers as a full-service service provider. The group employs around 3,000 people. Our network in Europe and the USA offers flexible and specialized solutions for six technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules and Oligonucleotides. We strive for excellence in supporting this network and are committed to providing the highest quality products for the benefit of patients. Our People Vision: We strive for excellence. We share our passion. Together, we make a difference in patients’ lives. Employee Logistics (m/f/d)

• 01 August 2026

descriptionByLocale.en:
CordenPharma is a leading provider for the development and manufacture of pharmaceutical active ingredients (APIs), adjuvants, finished medicines and packaging activities with more than 2,600 employees worldwide. With our services, we support pharmaceutical and biotech companies in the production of medicines with the primary goal of improving people’s lives. Our network in Europe and the USA offers flexible and specialized solutions on five technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectable, Highly Potent & Oncology; and Small Molecules. We strive to deliver the highest quality in all these areas for the benefit of patients. At the earliest possible time, we are looking for an Analytical Scientist, 100% (m/f/d) Department QC & Analytics at the Liestal site.
• Liestal
• By agreement
• Full time
• Perpetual Your exciting task area
• Development, revision, qualification and validation of existing and new analytical methods for pharmaceutical raw materials, adjuvants, active ingredients and intermediates according to cGMP specifications
• Independent processing of analytical work to support development and production
• Support in the preparation of GMP-relevant documents such as analytical test methods, validation reports or laboratory and work instructions
• Troubleshooting and processing of investigations. Your profile
• Completed chemical laboratory training
• Mind. 2 years of professional experience in analytical development or instrumental analytics
• Experience in the cGMP environment
• Reliable, team-capable and resilient personality with an independent and structured way of working
• Experience in common analytical methods with a focus on HPLC/GC
• Good knowledge of German as well as specialist English skills in words and writing
• Good computer user knowledge. What we offer you workweek 40 hours + 45 minutes pre-cooking time for a total of 4 bridge days per year Every day we work 8 hours and provide an additional 9 minutes per day; This means that we benefit from 4 bridge days per year as early working hours. Good transport connections Corden Pharma offers you interesting and versatile tasks in a highly motivated team. Through a practice-oriented training, we help you quickly gain professional security in order to work independently with a high level of personal responsibility.
